steps.script: const r = document.querySelector('#fallbackPage > [data-jfbm-page="clips"]'); const k = (id) => String(id || '').replace(/-/g, '').toLowerCase(); const row = (id) => r && id ? r.querySelector('.jfbm-clips-row[data-jfbm-clip="' + k(id) + '"]') : null; const ids = [__vars.seed.golf, __vars.seed.hotel, __vars.seed.india].map(k); const first = {}; ids.forEach(id => { first[id] = row(id); }); const texts = []; const lastText = {}; let samePatched = true; const until = Date.now() + 230000; for (;;) { let done = 0; for (const id of ids) { const x = row(id); if (!x) continue; const st = x.getAttribute('data-jfbm-state'); const t = x.querySelector('.jfbm-clip-state-text').textContent; if (lastText[id] !== t) { lastText[id] = t; texts.push(id.slice(0, 6) + ' ' + t); } if (st === 'InProgress' && x !== first[id]) samePatched = false; if (st === 'Ready') done++; } if (done === ids.length) break; if (Date.now() > until) throw new Error('the clips weren\'t done in time: ' + texts.slice(-6).join(' | ')); await new Promise(res => setTimeout(res, 100)); } return { samePatched, texts, queued: texts.some(t => / Queued · Accurate$/.test(t)), percents: texts.filter(t => / Making the clip \d+% · Accurate$/.test(t)).length, ready: ids.map(id => row(id).querySelector('.jfbm-clip-state-text').textContent) };
